heading.title: Of the Fees for Registration, Searches and Copies

article.title: Publication of fees.
article.content: A table of the fees so payable shall be published in the Official Gazette, and a copy thereof in English and the vernacular language of the district shall be exposed to public view in every registration office.
article.html:
79Publication of fees.

Section 79 · Part XIII · page 48 of the Act

A table of the fees so payable shall be published in the Official Gazette, and a copy thereof in English and the vernacular language of the district shall be exposed to public view in every registration office.
